合成数学示例数据。拖动“斜率 a”滑块（范围 -5 到 5）后，曲线与表格会使用同一组 9 个采样点（x 从 -2 到 2，含端点）在本地同步更新；默认 a=1 时对应 y=x+1。如果采样出现定义域错误，无效结果会保留为 null 缺口，不填零，也不会跳过对应区间。

```kelivo-ui
ui 1 catalog "kelivo.native/1"
root = Column(children=[aInput, chart, table])
$a: number = 1
let points = @sample(x => $a * x + 1, -2, 2, 9)
aInput = Slider(label="斜率 a", bind=$a, min=-5, max=5, step=0.1, digits=1)
chart = Chart(kind="line", data=points, x="x", y=["y"], unit="u", title="合成数学示例：y = a·x + 1")
table = DataTable(data=points, rowKey="x", columns=[{"key":"x","label":"x","digits":1},{"key":"y","label":"y","digits":2}])
```
